name: Ardent Blaze / Ardent Blaze 2 / Ardent Blaze 3

mechanics.claim: The bolt explodes in a cross pattern on hitting an enemy or reaching max range, dealing magic damage and granting sight of the area for 1 second.
mechanics.quote: fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit by the explosion are marked for 6 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Lucian gains bonus movement speed for 1 second whenever he or an ally damages a marked target, and allied triggers also grant him Lightslinger's attack-speed-reset buff (Vigilance).
mechanics.quote: '''Lucian''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.

mechanics.claim: DoTs proc the mark's movement speed trigger only once.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|persistent damage|DoTs}} will proc ''Ardent Blaze'' only once.

mechanics.claim: The bonus movement speed is not granted if the attack on a marked target is dodged, blocked, or missed due to blind.
mechanics.quote: '''Lucian''' will not gain ''Ardent Blaze's'' bonus movement speed if attacks on {{as|marked|buzzword}} targets are {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or if missed while the attacker is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: The spell casts from wherever Lucian is standing at the end of the cast time, not from where he was when he began casting.
mechanics.quote: ''Ardent Blaze'' will cast from wherever '''Lucian''' is at the end of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not prevent the mark from being applied.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the mark.
